name: RAR
description: Opens RAR archives from picked files: list the entries and extract them. Extraction only; the format cannot be created.

operations.name: rar.list
operations.description: Reads a RAR archive's entries: names, sizes, and whether each is a file or folder.
operations.howto: Archive browser pattern: file.pick feeds "file", run on the pick's click (chain list right after pick), route entries to state, and show them in a list with row bindings on item.name and item.size. Give each row an Extract button.

operations.name: rar.extract
operations.description: Extracts one entry by name and answers it as a file; password-protected archives are refused.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The entry to extract, from rar.list's rows

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The extracted entry; chains into file.save

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Renderer url; images and pdfs from the archive show in viewer elements

operations.howto: Wire it to each row's Extract button with "name" bound from item.name and "file" from the picked archive's state key, then chain file.save with the "file" output, or bind a viewer's src from "url" for media entries.
